Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

JailbreakBench: An Open Robustness Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Language Models (2404.01318v5) · paper method: The JailbreakBench paper states that proper test-time-defense evaluation should use attacks adapted to the defense; transfer attacks from undefended models give only a lower bound on worst-case attack success.
